7072907.sourceDescription: While Santa is making a list and checking it twice, deck your halls with our ultimate seasonal spruce! Just pop it back in its box for next Christmas. jx7kv25m.sourceDescription: This Contemporary Metal Christmas Tree embodies the fusion of modern design aesthetics and traditional holiday spirit. Its sleek metal structure brings an unconventional chic to any living space, garden, or terrace, offering a refreshing alternative to traditional evergreen trees. With the minimalist yet elegant design, this tree becomes a versatile decor piece, perfect for those who appreciate a contemporary touch during the festive season. Standing tall, it is an eye-catching centerpiece that captivates attention and adds a unique festive charm to your home. Materials: The tree is constructed from powder-coated steel, known for its abrasion resistance, which ensures longevity and maintains the tree's aesthetic appeal over the years. This material choice provides the tree with robustness, capable of withstanding the hustle and bustle of the festive arrangements without compromising its design. The powder coating also gives the tree a non-reflective, matte finish that blends seamlessly with any contemporary decor theme. Included Components: Delivered as 1 x Metal Christmas tree, the tree includes a sturdy steel stand for reliable support. Its construction ensures it holds firmly in place whether adorning your living room or the terrace. This essential component allows the tree to remain upright, providing a stable base that invites creativity in decorating with your favorite ornaments and lights. Features /Function /Design: With a contemporary design, this tree stands out as a striking holiday decoration. Its non-traditional form encourages versatility in holiday layouts, allowing users to integrate it into various interior styles, from minimalistic to modern chic. The tree’s design is characterized by a sleek, streamlined look, making it an appealing accent piece year-round. Recommended Uses: Perfect for indoor and sheltered outdoor use, the tree can beautify living rooms, gardens, and terraces. It serves not only as a Christmas tree but transforms these spaces into festive retreats, allowing homeowners to express their modern style and creativity during the holiday season. Care &Maintenance: Assembly requires only one person and a screwdriver, following the manufacturer's instructions. This simplified process ensures that homeowners can set up the tree effortlessly. When not in use, disassemble with care to maintain its structural integrity and store it to protect the finish for future holidays. Product Specifications Colour: Gold Material: Powder-coated steel Tree height: 148 cm Stand size: 55 x 24 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Metal Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

rckgqcws.sourceDescription: Bring a seasonal touch to your home with a beautiful artificial decorative wreath, available in a choice of summer, autumn, winter and Christmas designs. Simply select your preferred seasonal style to create the perfect look for your home. Ideal for decorating front doors, porches, walls, windows, hallways and other areas around the home, these versatile artificial wreaths are an easy way to refresh your décor throughout the year. Choose a bright and colourful summer design, warm autumnal style, elegant winter decoration or festive Christmas wreath to suit the season. Designed with decorative artificial flowers, foliage and seasonal details, these wreaths offer the look of natural seasonal decoration without the maintenance required by fresh flowers and foliage. They can be enjoyed year after year as part of your seasonal decorations. Perfect for everyday home décor as well as Christmas decorating, seasonal celebrations, parties and special occasions, these artificial wreaths make a simple and attractive addition to your home. Please note that each seasonal option is a separate design. Please select your preferred summer, autumn, winter or Christmas wreath from the available variations. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference.
